_comment: Pinned starter-CLI versions that correspond to what is CURRENTLY BAKED into ghcr.io/.../agent-hub/scaffold-base:latest. The weekly .github/workflows/base-images.yml job runs scripts/check-starter-versions.mjs against this manifest — if the npm-registry 'latest' dist-tag has moved to a HIGHER MAJOR for any entry, the workflow skips the ':latest' image retag and opens a GitHub issue tagged 'template-major-bump' so a human can validate the new major before we ship a potentially-breaking scaffold (e.g. next 15 → 16 might change App Router APIs, expo 3 → 4 might drop an iOS min version). Minor/patch bumps are allowed silently — the weekly rebuild picks them up automatically. Pins must match the ARG defaults in docker/scaffold-base/Dockerfile.

create-next-app.notes: Next.js App Router scaffold. Bumping major requires re-checking the --app / --src-dir / --import-alias CLI flag surface.

create-expo-app.notes: Expo bare/managed scaffold. Bumping major requires re-checking --template blank-typescript availability.

pnpm.notes: pnpm package manager (installed globally in pr-env-base). Major bumps occasionally change the lockfile format.

yarn.notes: Yarn Classic. We deliberately do NOT track Berry (yarn 2+) here — it's a separate binary with different config expectations; migrating would be a deliberate decision, not a silent major bump.

gh.notes: GitHub CLI. Installed via apt, not npm — the detector fetches the latest release via the GitHub Releases API for this one entry (see scripts/lib/starter-versions-core.mjs::fetchLatestVersion). Bumping major would signal a breaking auth-flow change.
